title: mycourse.work module manifest (modules/<module-id>/manifest.json)
description: A module is a reusable unit that courses list by id. The edge router (resolveBlueprint) reads these fields and serves lesson paths from inside the module folder. Unknown fields are allowed but ignored; validate_course.py warns about them. Rules a schema cannot express (id must equal the folder name, unique lesson ids, files must exist) are in RULES.md.

id.description: Must equal the module folder name. Kebab-case recommended. Never change after publishing: progress records point at it.

description.description: Shown on the module card. Recommended.

relativePath.description: Relative to the module folder, and must stay inside it.

id.description: Unique in the module. Plain kebab-case; the platform adds the module prefix itself (no legacy '|||' ids).

markdownPath.description: Lesson Markdown. Must start with '# Title' and have no YAML front matter.
